column1: # Project partition table -- published by `phpflash partitions publish` from board "esp32-s3-zero".
# It overrides the board's committed table for THIS project only; `phpflash build` picks it up
# automatically just by being here (delete it to fall back to the board default).
# You may change:
#   - factory (the app partition): resize it. It must hold the ~3 MB firmware AND leave room
#     for the auto-generated storage/phpstore partitions within 4MB flash. App partitions
#     start on a 64 KB boundary. See the size table below.
#   - nvs: 16K-64K is plenty (Wi-Fi calibration + IDF NVS).
#   - add your own `data` partitions if you need them.
# Sensible `factory` sizes for esp32-s3-zero (4000K usable of 4096K flash):
#   factory   free       note
#   3072K     ~928K      roomier embedded source / store
#   3456K     ~544K      board default
#   3712K     ~288K      tighter -- small source only
#   3840K     ~160K      max embedded (little room for source/store)
# Do NOT add these here -- they are generated per build and appended automatically:
#   - storage  (embedded PHP source FAT)  -> size it with [storage] reserve_kb
#   - phpstore (persistent store_* NVS)   -> enable it with [store] size_kb
# Any storage/phpstore line here is ignored.
# Sizes take K/M suffixes; leave Offset blank to auto-place.
# Name
nvs
phy_init
factory
